statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting each division's binding rules
Group CISO accountable; Payments Qualified Individual and Consulting HIPAA Security Official designated in writing
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering data held by other divisions; roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance yearly
Sanctions documented
Security review, written agreement, and reassessment for vendors, sub-processors, and affiliates
regulatory_driver: N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(f)); N51-R01 (Start with Security 8); PCI DSS 12.8

statement_summary: Annual common control assessment and division samples; external assurance on schedule
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard with a privacy impact assessment
Public and contractual statements owned, evidenced, reviewed quarterly, corrected within 10 business days
Unique identities in SYS-G1; acquired identities migrate within 18 months
Role-based least privilege with data owner approval
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators and CDE access
No new static cloud keys; workload identity; scoped, owned, certified service identities
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination
Quarterly certification including partner roles and service identities
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM with recording
Vendor and remote access only through PAM or the client access gateway; no VPN without device checks
Partner and project access ticket-linked and time-boxed
Administrator MFA for external users; re-authentication and notice for bank changes
One written plan and one notification matrix for all divisions
One severity scale
Report suspected incidents immediately; cross-division events within 1 hour
Every notice in the matrix sent by its deadline
regulatory_driver: 12 CFR 53.4; N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(j)); N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.410); state breach laws

statement_summary: Disclosure committee briefed within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of a materiality determination
Annual cross-division tabletop; quarterly playbook tests
Leaked credentials revoked within 1 hour
Every data set inventoried with class, owner (the division with the legal duty), and purposes
Restricted data under owner-controlled keys with object-level read logging
Single-recipient flows for Restricted data between divisions; no shared storage
New data uses, including AI tuning, need a privacy impact assessment and contract check
Retention periods (handoff 7 days; exports 30 days; terminated tenants 90 days; client data at project close)
Media sanitized with certificates
FCI only in the federal project area
Cardholder data only inside the CDE; tokens outside
Only managed devices with group EDR access Restricted or Confidential data
Code and scripts only in group-hosted repositories
Annual awareness and role-based training
Approved generative AI tools only; no Restricted data; client opt-in; no federal use without approval
Call-back verification for payroll, bank, or payment change requests
